EXT.evidence: Drives the exchange with blunt interruptions and questions (“already told that part”; “what’s the complicated issue?”; “Then what?”) and speaks so loudly another remarks even someone in a coma “did not quite hear” them (u002, u005, u007, u006).

AGR.evidence: Tactlessly undercuts Speaker_01’s romantic story (“already told the… magical feeling”) and publicly blurts sensitive details that Speaker_02 left for another woman; another notes the volume (u002, u005, u006).

CON.evidence: No clear behavior about being organized/efficient vs. sloppy/careless; a correction and some gossip are insufficient to judge conscientiousness.

NEU.evidence: Shows confidence rather than nervousness—speaks loudly and presses others for details without hesitation (u002, u005, u007), with another commenting on their volume (u006).

OPN.evidence: Asks follow-up questions about the situation, but this is situational curiosity rather than evidence of imaginative or unconventional thinking.
